name: Multi-Channel Inbound Lead Automation & Multi-Turn SMS Booking Engine

parameters.content:
## MODULE 1 — Client Onboarding
Typeform webhook ➜ normalize ➜ UPSERT `client_configs`.
Upsert key: `client_id` (`?on_conflict=client_id`, `Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates`).

## MODULE 2 — Multi-Channel Intake
**A** Twilio voice status (`no-answer` / `busy` / `failed` / `completed`+0s)
**B** IMAP lead notifications
**C** Public web-form webhook
**D** Twilio inbound SMS — closes the multi-turn loop.
Opt-out keywords (STOP/CANCEL/HELP…) are dropped
before they reach OpenAI; Twilio owns that list.

All four fan into one normalizer.

## MODULE 3 — Normalize + Tenant Resolve
Unified schema, then PostgREST lookup on
`twilio_phone_number` OR `client_id`.
Miss ➜ logged, branch halts (no SMS).

## MODULE 4 — Multi-Turn SMS Engine
History ➜ messages array ➜ GPT-4o-mini (JSON mode)
➜ hardened parse ➜ Twilio SMS ➜ persist both turns.

## MODULE 5 — Booking + Ledger
Confirmed ➜ Cal.com v1 booking (per-tenant API key)
All paths ➜ Google Sheets append.

## MODULE 6 — Cold-Lead Re-Engagement
Every 30 min: pull `lead_threads` where `status=nurturing`
and `next_followup_at <= now` (tenant config joined inline).

**Gate** enforces quiet hours in the *tenant* timezone
(default 08:00–21:00), the per-client cadence ladder
(`followup_cadence_hours`, default `{2,24,72}` hours),
and a 10-lead cap per sweep.

**Loop batch size = 1.** This is load-bearing: the shared
Module 4/5 chain uses `.first()` throughout, so exactly one
lead may be in flight per pass. `IF Followup Sweep Run`
is the guard that keeps webhook traffic out of the loop.

Ladder exhausted ➜ `status=dead`, no further nudges.

## Compliance — STOP / START
Dropped inbound SMS still updates thread state:
STOP/CANCEL/UNSUBSCRIBE ➜ `opted_out` (nudges cease).
START/UNSTOP ➜ back to `nurturing`, ladder reset.
Scoped by lead **and** tenant number, so opting out of
one client never silences another.

## ERROR SPINE
Every external call uses `onError: continueErrorOutput`
+ 3 retries. Red edges funnel into one normalizer
and a Supabase `error_log` insert. The Error Trigger
catches anything that still escapes.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, client_id: $json.client_id, message: "Client configuration saved." }) }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ /(new lead|new enquiry|new inquiry|contact form|quote request|website lead)/i.test(($json.subject || '') + ' ' + ($json.textPlain || '')) }}

={{ (() => { const ch = $('Normalize Lead Payload').first().json.channel_source; if (ch === 'web_form') { return !!$json.webhook_secret && $('Normalize Lead Payload').first().json.presented_secret === $json.webhook_secret; } if (ch === 'sms' || ch === 'missed_call') { return $json.twilio_signature_valid === true; } return true; })() }}

={{ (() => { const b = $json || {}; const c = $('Verify Twilio Signature').first().json; return (b.tenant_hour || 0) < c.max_sms_per_hour && (b.tenant_day || 0) < c.max_sms_per_day && (b.lead_hour || 0) < c.max_sms_per_lead_per_hour && (b.lead_day || 0) < c.max_sms_per_lead_per_day; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, temperature: $json.temperature, max_tokens: $json.max_tokens, response_format: $json.response_format, messages: $json.messages }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(
($('Parse AI Response').first().json.channel_source === 'followup' ? [] : [
  {
    client_id: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.client_id,
    lead_phone: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.lead_phone,
    role: 'user',
    content: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.inbound_message,
    channel_source: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.channel_source,
    turn: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.turn,
    execution_id: $execution.id,
    created_at: new Date(Date.now() - 1000).toISOString()
  }
]).concat([
  {
    client_id: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.client_id,
    lead_phone: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.lead_phone,
    role: 'assistant',
    content: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.reply,
    channel_source: 'sms',
    turn: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.turn,
    booking_intent: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.booking_intent,
    is_followup: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.channel_source === 'followup',
    followup_step: $('Parse AI Response').first().json.followup_step,
    twilio_sid: $json.sid || null,
    execution_id: $execution.id,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
])
) }}
